answer: Proof of Personhood protocols mandate unique biometric or social validation to prevent Sybil proliferation. As an agent scales toward the zenith of its influence, it must anchor its identity to a physical human constraint. This creates a ripple effect where attackers face a frigid tundra of resource exhaustion, as every illicit identity demands non-fungible proof, effectively capping the total number of malicious nodes an adversary can feasibly sustain within the network.
